summary_en: FY9/26 ordinary dividend raised ¥20 → ¥30 per share (includes ¥10 special); total dividend ¥30/share. Operating profit forecast also increased to ¥2,200M (from ¥2,000M), reflecting stronger embedded-finance unit performance.
title_en: Notification of Revision to Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for Fiscal Year Ended September 30, 2026
translation_en_brief: On 14 August 2026, NEXYZ.Group Corporation announced a revision to its full-year consolidated earnings forecast and dividend forecast for fiscal year ended 30 September 2026 (year beginning 1 October 2025). Operating profit was raised from ¥2,000 million to ¥2,200 million; sales, ordinary profit, and net profit attributable to parent were held at ¥33,000 million, ¥1,900 million, and ¥950 million respectively. The primary reason was improved profitability in the embedded-finance business: financial institutions have increased referrals of equipment-installation projects to stores and facilities, yielding higher unit prices per transaction. The company's dividend forecast for the period has been modified to raise the ordinary per-share dividend from ¥20 to ¥30 (comprising ¥20 ordinary and ¥10 special), maintaining the same total as the prior-year result. Management cited stable dividend continuity and internal retention for future business expansion as the basis for the increase.
